Marissa — forwarding a request from Rivet Health. Quick summary and recommendation below:

Summary:
- Current pilot end: 2027-01-31
- Asks: $10k additional onboarding credits + 6-week extension
- Upside: customer indicates intention to sign 12-month reserved capacity (estimated ARR: $180k/year)
- Risk: procurement could still walk; credits are one-time and timing-sensitive

Suggested approval terms (to limit downside):
1) Approve $10k onboarding credit, applied as a one-time promo credit on first invoice after contract signature.
2) Approve 6-week extension conditional on receiving a signed LOI or email from VP-level stakeholder by end of extension week 2. If no LOI, extension reverts and credits are void.
3) Require SOC-2 evidence exchange to be completed during extension; Jordan to confirm no technical blockers.

Attachments: SOW_RivetHealth_v2.pdf (proposed SOW with commercial terms)

Recommendation: Approve under the conditional terms above — high probability of conversion and fits our onramp playbook for payer deals.

Thanks,
